MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

2. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

8. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 8
   D. 18

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

10. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

11. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — 10

3. B — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²

4. B — 15
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144

Final Answer: 15 cm
